name: starknet
description: Starknet explorer + contract studio + APPS, one port. Every app on Starknet here (stablecoins, privacy, contracts, cairo, starktime, zquorum, zuma, zkwasm, and any you make) is a submod at mods/<name> = starknet.<name>, listed in the Apps tab; + New app scaffolds one (config.json + mod.py + app/index.html, no build). The app: live blocks, transactions, wallets, any contract read through its own on-chain ABI, the STRK20 privacy pool's public side, every stablecoin with its live supply and oracle peg, an ASK agent that explains the protocol on the fleet agent contract, and a BUILD studio where you write, build and test Cairo contracts with an agent that edits them for you (via the cairo mod's scarb + snforge). The API: JSON-RPC reads over a failover pool of free public endpoints, Cairo ABI codec, STRK20 pool tools, studio verbs, and 34 MCP tools over stdio and POST /mcp. Backend is Python stdlib only.

endpoints.search: GET /search?q=  (block number | tx | block hash | address | token alias)
endpoints.studio_write: POST /studio/{new,write,build,test,vibe,clean,remove} — owner token (header token: or Authorization: Bearer) or loopback; build/test/vibe return {job} to poll
endpoints.mods: GET /mods  the sibling Starknet mods (= the kind:mod apps), live — kept for old callers
endpoints.contracts: GET /contracts  (your Cairo contracts with devnet addresses + well-known mainnet contracts)
endpoints.fund: GET /fund (balances) · POST /fund {target=1000} — top every devnet account + contract of the Starknet mods up to target ETH+STRK (owner/loopback)
endpoints.app_page: GET /starknet/apps/<name>/  the app itself (html apps from mods/<name>/app; page/mod apps redirect)

backend: python stdlib only (http.server + urllib) in api/; keccak-256 and starknet_keccak in-tree; Cairo ABI codec in-tree (api/abi.py); MCP server in-tree (api/mcp.py). App: Next 14 static export in app/, no node process at runtime.
auth: Chain side is read-only — no keys held, nothing signed or submitted. The contract studio's reads are open; its writes (new/write/build/test/vibe/clean/remove) edit files on this box and vibe spends the host Claude account, so they need a mod-protocol token signed by an owner (config owner, the build private-flag owner, or STARKNET_STUDIO_OWNERS) or a direct loopback call. STRK20 private transactions need the user's viewing key and a STARK proof; this module never asks for one.

env.STARKNET_RPC: your own node — always tried first, no third party contacted if it answers
env.STRK20_POOL: override the STRK20 pool address (STRK20_POOL_SEPOLIA for sepolia, none is built in)
env.STARKNET_ABI_CACHE: where class ABIs are cached by class hash (default ~/.mod/starknet/abi)
env.STARKNET_CAIRO: the cairo workbench API the studio proxies to (default http://127.0.0.1:51291/cairo/api)
env.STARKNET_STUDIO_OWNERS: extra addresses allowed to write in the studio (comma list)
env.STARKNET_AGENT_CLAUDE: orbit/claudecode base url for the ask agent's claude brain (default http://127.0.0.1:51260; empty disables)

layout.api: api/ — api.py (server), chain.py, abi.py, strk20.py, studio.py (contract studio -> cairo mod), fund.py (devnet funding), mcp.py (python stdlib)
layout.app: app/ — Next.js static export, built by app/build.sh into app/dist, served by api/api.py
layout.mods: mods/<name>/ — one submod per app (starknet.<name>): config.json (app block: kind page|mod|html, title, icon, tone, tag, pitch, order) + mod.py (class Mod: facts() + fns) + README; html apps add app/index.html. Template: api/app_template/. Registry: api/apps.py

brains.facts: open, no model, live chain readings
brains.claude: owner/loopback — orbit/claudecode POST /run/stream with the readings as context
